title: fix: probe community image edits and improve provider feedback
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds targeted image-edit probes and alternates edits/generation for advertised image-input models without increasing routine request volume.
- Records operation, timestamp, HTTP status, and request ID; rejects stream error events even when they include choices.
- Gives providers evidence-based tool/caching feedback and requires matching-operation recovery checks, with existing thresholds and message limits preserved.
- Updates the EC2 installation file list; no secrets, billing, catalog schema, or gateway changes.
- Verified: 8 focused tests, Biome, Node/shell syntax, and diff checks. Follow-up to #14595; EC2 rollout and one live edit smoke test after merge.

gist.headline: The garden checks its edits
gist.blurb: The community monitor now alternates image-generation and image-edit probes, so providers get clearer evidence when a model’s advertised tools need tending.
gist.summary: Added targeted image-edit probing for advertised image-input models, alternating edit and generation checks while recording operation, timestamps, HTTP status, and request IDs for provider feedback and matching-operation recovery validation.
gist.impact: Provider diagnostics can now distinguish image-edit behavior from generation behavior without increasing routine probe volume, helping maintain more accurate capability and caching feedback.
gist.visual_concept: Polli is a careful garden inspector testing two neighboring code-plants: one produces a fresh pixel flower and the other gently edits an existing flower. A CRT monitor robot holds a tiny diagnostic clipboard with checkmarks, request IDs, and status lights, representing evidence-based provider feedback and operation-specific checks.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and tiny inspector glasses, alternating between watering a fresh code-flower and carefully trimming an existing pixel flower labeled "EDIT"; a friendly CRT monitor robot records little checkmarks beside them. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, code-plants and garden vines, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, subtle pixel-font text: "CHECK BOTH".
